trickyParts: The wake decides by branch order (no assistant entry after the card), ctx.isIdle() and runSeq, never by event order: the host emits the extension agent_end unawaited and a fold's message_end may come before or after it. A card not yet in the branch counts as unread, since the host persists message_end in one FIFO chain (agent-session.ts #queueMessageEndPersistence).

Startup phase: the host has no event after its startup send drain, so an idle card in the phase goes followUp with no triggerTurn; its own message_end (only possible after the hold settles) arms the check on the host timer, and a host idle at that macrotask has no tracked send pending. Unseen startup cards hold the check up to 30 s (STARTUP_CARD_CAP_MS).
Interrupt flag: aborted assistant 'Interrupted by user', auto_compaction_end aborted, auto_retry_end 'Retry cancelled'; cleared at agent_start. Startup cards ignore it, as the steer they replace did.
deviations: Plan said comment on and close #2266 myself; the architect asked instead that session 01a16962 close it, so I sent it the PR number (Envoy e18734ab5d7a4d852f433185ea8cec55).

Plan's (c) negative control was 'red at #2266 head 67bc2ad9'; with the startup phase, that run fails earlier, at the first card's wake expectation, so the meaningful control is the late-fold wake disabled at head (timed out); the 67bc2ad9 swap is quoted for the startup case instead.
Wake text is 'N Envoy message(s) above arrived with no turn to read it/them: read and act ...', true for a session with no turn yet.

A session that receives no card while it starts stays in the startup phase until its first idle card, which gets its turn through the wake rather than a direct steer (documented limit; the architect accepted the followUp design, Envoy bee6c3e7b60c503b1c26c93ebdddcacf).
